parameters.name: CpuCount
parameters.description: The modified maximum number of CPU cores. The minimum value is 1. The maximum value is determined by the cluster kernel parameter resource_control_cpu_count_limit. You must specify one and only one of this parameter and MaxCpu.

parameters.name: MaxCpu
parameters.description: The modified maximum CPU quota percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. You must specify one and only one of this parameter and CpuCount.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the PolarDB cluster.
> You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~) operation to query available regions.

parameters.name: ResourceControlName
parameters.description: The name of the resource control rule. The name must be 1 to 63 ASCII bytes in length, start with a letter, and can contain only letters, digits, and underscores.
